column1: # Exonym of a town -> its local name: a place name as people of another language write it. Facts, no country branch:
# read for every sheet alike, and only when the town written is not a commune of the sheet itself.
# Towns only: an island or a region written as the last segment ("…, Sóller, Majorca") would be put in one town of it
# and pull every address of the island there (a house in Sóller answered in Palma, 16 km away).
